name: Sugawara Masakuni
source:
[i]"Many times have I longed... to get my hands on you."[/i]

Lord Masakuni is the chief council of state, and is trusted greatly by the Emperor, as well as the military officers around him. He excels at martials arts, but he is also an educated man, and he is worthy of being by the Emperor's side.

Lord Masakuni is manly, yet kind, and revered by many including myself! He lost his wife when he was young and it seems he hasn't been in any romances since, so perhaps he has permanently lost his "Face of a Man".

A crying shame for such a reliable and wonderful person.

[[url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Masakuni_Sugawara]From Hinata's notes[/url]]
